BRCA1 is associated with four diseases: familial cancer of breast, familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1, pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4, and Fanconi anemia complementation group S.⁠1–4 I found 4 conditions related to BRCA1.⁠1–4

BRCA1, and the gene name is BRCA1.⁠8, 9 The gene produces a protein that helps keep DNA stable and acts as a tumor suppressor.⁠23

One is double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.⁠24 Another is DNA repair.⁠25 Another is regulation of DNA repair.⁠26 Another is DNA damage tolerance.⁠27
